name: BACH_0151
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review

All confidence signals agree; worklist tier 2 because Invasive is the top class [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% | Near-certain |
| Conformal set (90%) | Invasive only | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 26th percentile | Typical, clean input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Invasive | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept association with invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 7, 10) · ↑ invasive · Second-strongest invasive association [F4] · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 6, 9, 10) · context · Higher than every reference image [F8] · Measured
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 6, 9, 10) · context · 57% neoplastic nuclei; above 91% of references [F7] · Measured
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 1, 6) · ↑ invasive · Scored high, but failed spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier; mitoses is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Calibration was tested on only 132 images; ECE 0.05, CI up to 0.18.
- Cell measurements cover regions 6, 9, 10 only; concept scores are associations.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 7**: confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 6**: count mitoses yourself; the model score failed its spot check.
3. **Region 8**: look for an in-situ component; the duct-confined score is only weakly validated.
